import re,glob
lines=open('src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts').read().split('\n')
def find(title):
    hits=[i+1 for i,l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"\bit\(\s*['\"`]"+re.escape(title)+r"['\"`]",l)]
    return hits
pat=re.compile(r"\[validated by: ([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]*chatOrchestrator\.test\.ts)#L(\d+)\)")
files=glob.glob('**/*.md',recursive=True)
for f in files:
    if 'node_modules' in f: continue
    s=open(f).read()
    def rep(m):
        t,path,n=m.group(1),m.group(2),int(m.group(3))
        h=find(t)
        if len(h)!=1:
            print('UNMAPPED',f,t,h); return m.group(0)
        if h[0]!=n: print('moved',f,t,n,'->',h[0])
        return f"[validated by: {t}]({path}#L{h[0]})"
    ns=pat.sub(rep,s)
    if ns!=s: open(f,'w').write(ns)
EOF

import subprocess
for p in ['specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md','specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md','specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md','.lore/dod.md']:
    orig=subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:'+p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split('\n')
    cur=open(p).read().split('\n')
    # drop blank lines added: rebuild by aligning non-blank content
    import difflib
    out=[]
    sm=difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,orig,cur,autojunk=False)
    for op,a1,a2,b1,b2 in sm.get_opcodes():
        if op=='equal': out+=orig[a1:a2]
        elif op=='insert':
            out+=[l for l in cur[b1:b2] if l.strip()]
        elif op=='replace':
            out+=[l for l in cur[b1:b2] if l.strip() or (b2-b1)==(a2-a1)]
        elif op=='delete': out+=orig[a1:a2] if all(not l.strip() for l in orig[a1:a2]) else []
    open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
EOF
